title: Interactive-Policy Distillation with Bidirectional Propose-and-Verify
abstract: arXiv:2609.36546v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its self-generated trajectories with dense token-level teacher feedback. However, naive OPD may suffer from teacher unanchoring, where the student's reasoning trajectory drifts far from the teacher, causing the teacher to be queried on states it would hardly visit and thus provide unreliable supervision. We propose Interactive-Policy Distillation (IPD), which applies adaptive teacher intervention to the student rollout. Under a bidirectional propose-and-verify state machine, the student and teacher alternately exchange their roles as proposer and verifier, and collaboratively generate mixed-source trajectories. Then different supervisions are applied according to the source of each token. This bidirectional propose-and-verify mechanism and the source-split loss make IPD not only a more performant distillation method, but also a unified bridge between on-policy and off-policy paradi

translated_title: 基于双向提议-验证机制的交互式策略蒸馏
translated_abstract: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）通过密集的词元级教师反馈，在学生模型自生成的轨迹上对其进行训练。然而，朴素的OPD可能遭受教师锚定失效问题，即学生的推理轨迹偏离教师太远，导致教师在学生几乎不会访问的状态上被查询，从而提供不可靠的监督。我们提出交互式策略蒸馏（IPD），将自适应的教师干预应用于学生的轨迹生成过程。在双向提议-验证状态机下，学生和教师交替交换提议者和验证者的角色，协同生成混合来源的轨迹，然后根据每个词元的来源施加不同的监督。这种双向提议-验证机制和来源分离损失使IPD不仅是一种性能更强的蒸馏方法，也是连接在策略与离策略范式的统一桥梁。
tldr: 提出交互式策略蒸馏（IPD），通过双向提议-验证机制让学生与教师交替交换角色协同生成混合来源轨迹，并按词元来源施加不同监督，解决了教师锚定失效问题，同时统一了在策略与离策略蒸馏范式。
en_tdlr: Interactive-Policy Distillation (IPD) employs a bidirectional propose-and-verify state machine where student and teacher alternately exchange proposer and verifier roles to collaboratively generate mixed-source trajectories with source-dependent supervision, solving teacher unanchoring and unifying on-policy and off-policy distillation paradigms.
